tasteProfile.profile: Warm, funny, character-led series; memorable ensembles; clever writing; optimism, redemption and satisfying arcs.
Strongest evidence for Ted Lasso, The Office (US), Scrubs, Schitt's Creek, The Good Place, New Girl, Lovesick and Colin from Accounts.
Repeated positive ratings for The Office (UK), Episodes, The Artful Dodger, Ghosts (UK), The Durrells and several travel titles.
Conan O'Brien Must Go and Travel Man Loved; Reluctant Traveler and Rick Steves' Europe Liked.
Home Town and Fixer to Fabulous Loved; Home Town: Ben's Workshop and Fixer to Fabulous: Italiano Liked. Location and host chemistry matter.
Avoid defaulting to bleak, cynical, relentlessly intense, or emotionally punishing dramas. Parenthood is Okay in the latest explicit rating.
Too dark/depressing/hopeless, excessive gore/violence, disturbing scenes, excessive sexual content/nudity, slow pacing, and too much supernatural/fantasy are dealbreakers.
Romance/sexual content: moderate tolerance; language: moderate; violence: mild preferred.
Not a blanket rejection: The Mandalorian, Andor, Stranger Things, The Queen's Gambit show openness to selected immersive/adventure storytelling. Recent sci-fi dislikes require caution.
Only series that have ended, ran at least 3 seasons, and whose final season was at least 2 years ago. Apply eligibility independently from personal rating.
Some ratings came from prior summaries and duplicate titles appeared across rounds. Verify conflicts and exact series editions before treating the catalog as final.

Latest round rating is used when a title recurs. Explicit prior corrections and previously stated favorites are applied where captured.
